title: AMS_ADRN at SemEval-2022 Task 5: A Suitable Image-text Multimodal Joint Modeling Method for Multi-task Misogyny Identification

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying multimodal memes (image and text) for misogyny identification using transformer-based single-flow and double-tower architectures, and predicting specific overlapping sub-categories including gender stereotypes, shaming, objectification, and violence on the MAMI dataset.
